WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        il.order_item_id,
        p.product_color,
        AVG(CAST(il.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(38, 10))) AS avg_invoiced_quantity,
        AVG(
            (il.derived_product_cost - il.derived_total_cost)
            / NULLIF(il.derived_total_cost, 0)
        ) AS avg_cost_difference_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS il
    INNER JOIN Order_Items AS oi
        ON oi.order_item_id = il.order_item_id
    INNER JOIN Products AS p
        ON p.product_id = il.product_id
    GROUP BY il.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked_groups AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id,
        product_color,
        avg_invoiced_quantity,
        avg_cost_difference_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_color
            ORDER BY avg_invoiced_quantity DESC
        ) AS quantity_rank
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_invoiced_quantity,
    avg_cost_difference_ratio,
    quantity_rank
FROM ranked_groups
WHERE quantity_rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: Assumes product_quantity contains values suitable for decimal numeric conversion; missing or invalid numeric values are excluded from its average. The ratio is undefined when derived_total_cost is zero, so those rows are ignored by that average.
